# Dispatch Records Export

Fictional fixture. IDs below are stable source locators. All available bodies are
included, but no raw data or additional source systems are available.

## O1 — Pilot goals

Date: 2024-01-15. Author: pilot owner. Complete goal statement below.

Target a 30% handling-time reduction by using automated routing plus barcode
confirmation. The alternative design uses the same automated router plus voice
confirmation. The current process uses manual routing and barcode confirmation.

## O2 — Pilot outcome memo

Date: 2024-04-30. Author: operations analyst. Complete result excerpt below.

The automated-routing/barcode pilot processed 300 cases. Timing data could be
matched to the earlier process for 240 cases; 60 lacked a comparable timing record.
The matched sample showed a 12% reduction in median handling time. Assignment was
not randomized, and workload mix changed. There was no voice-confirmation arm.

## O3 — Confirmation component evaluation

Date: 2024-03-02. Author: component researcher. Complete results excerpt below.

In a balanced bench task with 1,000 confirmation attempts per method, barcode
confirmation correctly recorded 99.8% and voice confirmation 95.0%. Both methods
used already-assigned items. This evaluated confirmation only; it did not run
routing or measure end-to-end workflow performance in operating conditions.

## O4 — Routing review

Date: 2024-04-30. Author: operations analyst. Complete result excerpt below.

Automated routing assigned the intended destination in 92% of 300 pilot cases.
Both proposed confirmation methods share this same router. A separate earlier
manual-routing audit reported 97% across 500 cases at another site and season.
Those populations and conditions differ, so this is not a controlled routing
comparison. There is no joint routing-and-confirmation success measurement.
